title: Hidden Accuracy and Superconvergence Analysis of Central Discontinuous Galerkin Methods on Overlapping Meshes
summary: This paper establishes the first rigorous superconvergence theory for semidiscrete and fully discrete central discontinuous Galerkin (CDG) methods for linear hyperbolic equations on overlapping meshes. While the optimal $L^2$ convergence of $\mathbb{Q}^k$ CDG schemes was established on uniform Cartesian meshes by Liu, Shu, and Zhang [ SIAM J. Numer. Anal.}, 56 (2018), pp. 520--541], their observed $\mathcal{O}(h^{k+2})$ pointwise superconvergence has remained unproven, due to the loss of standard single-mesh Galerkin orthogonality inherent in the CDG overlapping structure.
